fast_decision.description: Interactive decision regeneration. A fresh Official snapshot may be reused for at most 60 seconds inside the same working directory so a bounded warm retry does not refetch or perturb its own canonical evidence. The canonical official_snapshot.json remains ephemeral. A workspace-local retry mirror can restore it only inside the same job and is excluded from runtime-data hydration and publication, so every new production job still performs a fresh Official pull. REC-41 tactical-role/system fields are already published in runtime-data, so the temporary migration fence is closed and advanced player features may use the normal six-hour freshness window. Historical priors are still re-indexed every run so current Official club identity is reconciled against cached previous-season evidence. Prediction is declared with zero age so only exact content-addressed fingerprint reuse can qualify; stale age-based prediction reuse remains impossible.

live.description: Match/live decision path. REC-41 migration is complete; advanced player features may use the normal six-hour freshness window while historical priors remain transfer-aware on every run. Prediction is declared with zero age so only exact content-addressed fingerprint reuse can qualify; stale age-based prediction reuse remains impossible.
